name: PhotoKit
description_en:
PhotoKit at photokit.com is a browser photo editor advertising cutout, inpainting, clarity and exposure tools, plus batch image processing. It is distinct from Apple’s PhotoKit framework and unrelated products using similar names. The homepage, pricing and legal pages were readable in this follow-up after earlier timeouts.

The documented free/VIP distinction is mainly advertising and download allowances, rather than a simple list of locked editing tools. Teams evaluating client or business use should read both the usage terms and privacy disclosures: the homepage’s image-retention statement is narrower than a claim that the service collects no account or device data.
description_zh:
photokit.com 上的 PhotoKit 是浏览器照片编辑器，宣传抠图、修补、清晰度、曝光及批量图像处理。它不同于 Apple 的 PhotoKit 框架及其他近似同名产品。此前超时后，本轮已正常读取首页、价格及法律页面。

公开的免费/VIP 区别主要在广告与下载额度，不宜简单理解为编辑工具全部锁定。评估客户或商业用途时应同时阅读使用条款与隐私说明：首页关于图片留存的说法，比“完全不收集账户或设备数据”的范围更窄。

core_features.explanation_en: The homepage advertises cutout, inpainting and clarity/exposure adjustments without installing a desktop editor.
core_features.explanation_zh: 首页宣传无需安装桌面编辑器即可抠图、修补及调整清晰度和曝光。

core_features.explanation_en: The homepage lists batch image operations and multiple formats; exact format support must be checked for the chosen tool.
core_features.explanation_zh: 首页列出批量图像操作及多种格式，具体工具的格式支持仍需逐一确认。

core_features.name_zh: 免费与 VIP 下载额度
core_features.explanation_en: Pricing lists free access with advertisements and limited downloads, versus VIP without ads and with unlimited downloads.
core_features.explanation_zh: 价格页列出免费版含广告及有限下载，VIP 去广告并提供不限量下载。

pricing.notes_en: Displayed VIP durations: $9.99/30 days, $29.99/365 days, $99.99 Lifetime. Currency, renewal, tax and Lifetime definition not verified.
pricing.notes_zh: 页面 VIP 时长价格：30 天 $9.99、365 天 $29.99、Lifetime $99.99；币种、续费、税费及 Lifetime 定义未核实。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Evaluate a representative image and output
sections.title_zh: 用代表性图片检查处理与输出
sections.en: An appropriate first check is a non-sensitive sample: choose cutout or inpainting, inspect edges and fine details, then export at the required dimensions and format. This is proposed evaluation guidance, not a hands-on result. The homepage advertises batch PNG/JPG/BMP/GIF/TIFF/RAW processing, while the general terms name JPEG/PNG/GIF uploads. Do not assume every editing tool accepts every advertised batch format or produces lossless output.
sections.zh: 可先选择非敏感样图，使用抠图或修补，检查边缘和细节，再以所需尺寸及格式导出。这是评估建议，并非实测结果。首页宣传批处理 PNG/JPG/BMP/GIF/TIFF/RAW，而通用条款列出 JPEG/PNG/GIF 上传；不能假定每个编辑工具支持全部批量格式，或保证无损输出。

sections.en: The read pricing page offers VIP for 30 days at $9.99, 365 days at $29.99, or Lifetime at $99.99. It describes full features on the free plan with ads and limited downloads, while VIP removes ads and allows unlimited downloads. Struck-through prices are not the current offered amounts. The page uses a dollar symbol without establishing the checkout currency, and no purchase was made to verify tax, renewal, refund or the contractual meaning of Lifetime.
sections.zh: 实读价格页列出 VIP：30 天 $9.99、365 天 $29.99、Lifetime $99.99。免费版列为完整功能、含广告、下载有限；VIP 去广告且下载不限量。划线价不作为当前售价。页面使用美元符号式的 $，但没有确认结账币种；未购买，因此税费、续费、退款及 Lifetime 的合同定义仍未核实。

sections.title_en: Separate image retention from account telemetry
sections.title_zh: 区分图片留存与账户遥测
sections.en: The homepage says the server will not save user pictures and data. The privacy policy separately describes account, purchase, support, IP/device and clickstream data, third-party data, and FingerprintJS device identification. Its stated collection of account or device information means the service should not be summarized as collecting no data. These disclosures alone do not establish whether a specific editing operation stays on-device, its image-processing route, or an AI-training exclusion.
sections.zh: 首页称服务器不会保存用户图片和数据；隐私政策则另说明账户、购买、支持、IP/设备、点击流、第三方数据及 FingerprintJS 设备识别。既然政策列出账户或设备信息收集，就不能概括为完全不收集数据。这些说明本身也不能确定某项编辑是否完全在设备端完成、图片处理路径或是否排除 AI 训练。

sections.title_en: Check commercial permission and service terms
sections.title_zh: 检查商业使用许可与服务条款
sections.en: The terms state that users retain rights they already own in uploaded images, while the platform and its materials remain owned or licensed by the provider. They also contain broad wording requiring permission for commercial use of the website except commercial transactions with the provider. This does not give a clear blanket license for client workflows or every stock asset. Request clarification before relying on that scope; do not turn tool access into a rights guarantee. The browser editor was not exercised and output quality, privacy behavior and support response were not tested.
sections.zh: 条款称用户保留上传图片中原本拥有的权利，而平台及其材料由提供方拥有或获得许可。条款也广泛要求网站商业使用取得许可，但与提供方进行商业交易除外；这不足以明确授予所有客户工作流程或素材的通用许可。依赖该范围前需取得澄清，不能把工具可用等同于权利保证。本轮未操作编辑器，也未测试输出质量、隐私行为或支持响应。
